content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary — AUDIT: deviation (fallback target)**

- **Responsive clauses:** §9.8 Records (p0414), §9.9(a)–(d) Audit Procedures (p0416–p0419). Also checked §5.8 Development Records (mutual regulatory/patent record review, not a usage audit) and §6.9 (Sanofi auditing RevMed — benefits us, not flagged).
- **Why it fails fallback:** §9.9 is mutual, so RevMed can audit us. The frequency cap ([***] per Calendar Year) is both blank and subject to an open-ended "unless for cause" exception, so there is no effective once-per-year limit; the notice floor ([***]) and the cost-shift trigger ([***] percent) are likewise unquantified.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** 15 days' prior notice; once per Calendar Year with the for-cause exception deleted; cost shift only where underpayment exceeds ten percent (10%). Edits are surgical and remain reciprocal.
- **Already met (left untouched):** independent auditor of international prominence (9.9(a)) and auditor confidentiality agreement (9.9(d)). Preferred-only points (business hours, off-site, express no-systems-access) noted but not pressed, since the right reaches only books and records under §9.8.
